retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s studio portrait featuring a primary male subject in metallic outerwear against a dark background with a vintage luxury car and a secondary soft-focus figure.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in a shiny blue windbreaker and floral shirt, leaning against a classic purple luxury car. The background is a deep, dark void punctuated by a bright lens flare and a secondary female figure in a purple dress, creating a sense of narrative depth and soft-focus 1980s glamour.
coreVisualRelationships: Male subject in the right foreground as the primary focal point
Vintage car acting as a diagonal bridge between foreground and background
Secondary female figure in the left background providing depth
Bright lens flare on the left balancing the visual weight of the primary subject
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with deep blacks
Metallic or reflective textures on clothing and car
Soft-focus or slightly grainy film aesthetic

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the right third of the frame at a medium-close scale; secondary subject is small and soft-focus on the far left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary subject's face and the reflective blue of his jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the primary subject's face, follow the diagonal line of the car to the left, and rest on the secondary figure and lens flare.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the upper center and left creates a moody, nocturnal atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark navy (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic electric blue (jacket) and royal purple (car and dress)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and orange (floral shirt patterns and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic jacket and the dark background; saturation is concentrated in the clothing and car.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon greens or bright reds
Maintain a cool-toned base with warm skin accents

characterSpecificRedesigns: G with a simple bar and no spur

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the dark negative space at the top
contained within a semi-transparent blue horizontal bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide display text paired with condensed subtitle text.
graphicDevices: Semi-transparent blue rectangular bar behind the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric 80s aesthetic perfectly
Provides the necessary squareness and wide stance

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a metallic blue 80s jacket and floral shirt leaning on a purple vintage car. Include a soft-focus woman in a purple dress and a lens flare in the dark background on the left. Leave the top 20% of the image as dark negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in an ultra-wide white sans-serif font in the top left. Below it, add a horizontal blue bar containing the subtitle in a white condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the main title font significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the subtitle contained within a blue rectangular bar?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the wide header and condensed subheader?

mustRedesign: Avoid using modern flat design; maintain the 80s film grain and glow
Ensure the car is a vintage luxury model, not a modern vehicle

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the blue horizontal bar under the main text
Verify the man's jacket has a metallic/reflective sheen
Ensure the background is dark and moody
Confirm the secondary figure is appropriately out of focus
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Studio Portrait + Metallic Outerwear + Vintage Luxury Car + Wide Geometric Sans-Serif Typography
